speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your skin lesions, could you please describe how long they have been present and whether they are itchy or painful? Also, have you noticed any other symptoms like fever, rash elsewhere, or recent illnesses?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-year-old female. The patient's mother reports noticing multiple painless, nonpruritic papules on the child's abdomen. The child attends daycare where another child was reported to have similar lesions recently. Patient's brother had chickenpox one month ago. Immunizations are up-to-date.

speaker: Doctor
text: The contact with a sibling who had chickenpox one month ago strongly suggests a viral etiology, likely Molluscum contagiosum. I will examine the lesions closely to look for the characteristic central umbilication. REQUEST IMAGES
